decisions.reason: The citrus harvesting crate was publicly presented as a flagship of the firm's sustainability direction, so management would attribute its absence from the website in 2020-2021 to seasonal or pandemic-related adoption delays and keep it.

The multi-model foldable container line carries substantial sunk tooling investment and was visibly committed on its own page, so even without recent website evidence management would persist with it as core returnable packaging.
Stackable crates are central to the core portfolio and their mold investments justify persistence, though the line's low visibility and missing recent evidence make it somewhat more vulnerable.

The spill-retention pallet line has its own page and several models, so prior commitment favors keeping it, but it sits at the margin of transport packaging and is the most likely candidate for pruning.
